coreActions.label: Core Combat Options
coreActions.description: These actions are available to fighters during combat.

actions.name: Attack
actions.description: Make a weapon or natural attack.

actions.name: Overwatch Shot
actions.description: Aim at a chosen hex; the shot resolves when the trigger happens.
actions.mechanic: Delayed ranged attack at a target hex

actions.name: Block
actions.description: Block a close attack you can see coming.
actions.mechanic: Opposed block check vs incoming attack

actions.name: Evade
actions.description: Avoid an incoming attack by footwork, cover, or a quick shift of position.
actions.mechanic: Opposed evade check vs incoming attack

actions.name: Move / Reposition
actions.description: Step, sprint, vault cover, change elevation, close distance, or open distance.
actions.mechanic: Movement based on speed, terrain, and stamina

actions.name: Draw / Ready / Reload
actions.description: Swap weapons, ready gear, string an arrow, crank a crossbow, or prepare an item.

actions.name: Aim / Called Shot
actions.description: Spend time lining up a careful hit.
actions.mechanic: +2 attack check, choose a specific target area

actions.name: Defend / Hold Action
actions.description: Delay an action to react later in the round.
actions.mechanic: Set a trigger condition and act when it happens

actions.name: Disengage / Withdraw
actions.description: Back out of close fighting while protecting yourself.
actions.mechanic: Check to avoid a free attack while leaving reach

actions.name: Combat Technique
actions.description: Use a trained mundane maneuver to break guard, knock a foe prone, or control a weapon.

actions.name: Use a Skill
actions.description: Climb, hide, give first aid, track, rally, or perform another practical task under pressure.
actions.mechanic: Skill check with attribute bonus and training bonus

actions.name: Use an Item
actions.description: Bandage a wound, throw oil, drop caltrops, light a torch, or use carried gear.

bonuses.name: Actions per Round
bonuses.description: Experienced fighters can do more in a combat round.

bonuses.name: Combat Bonuses
bonuses.description: Training improves attack, block, evade, damage, and initiative checks.

bonuses.name: Weapon Training
bonuses.description: Training improves accuracy, blocks, handling, and ranged timing with specific weapons.

bonuses.name: Mounted Combat
bonuses.description: Mounted fighters can use speed, reach, and impact when conditions allow.

bonuses.name: Positioning Edge
bonuses.description: Good footwork, cover, and timing can create stronger attacks.

bonuses.name: Control Tools
bonuses.description: Trips, binds, feints, shoves, and disarms can change the fight without extra damage.

bonuses.name: First Aid and Rallying
bonuses.description: Stabilize allies, stop bleeding when possible, and help fighters recover composure.

bonuses.name: Protective Positioning
bonuses.description: Hold chokepoints, screen wounded allies, and maintain a defensive line.

bonuses.name: Natural Attacks
bonuses.description: Bites, tusks, horns, hooves, and claws for realistic animals that have them.

bonuses.name: Instinctive Movement
bonuses.description: Animals may sprint, charge, circle, or retreat based on training and temperament.

turnFlow.label: How a Turn Typically Flows

steps.description: Pick a target or position goal.
Spend one action to attack, move, block, evade, ready gear, or use a combat technique.
Continue until the fighter is out of actions or chooses to hold position.

tips: Budget actions; blocks and evades can consume them.

quickReferenceTips.budgeting: Every fighter has a limited number of actions per combat round.
quickReferenceTips.positioning: Use cover, reach, elevation, and flanks.
quickReferenceTips.timing: Hold actions for useful moments and interrupt enemy setup.
quickReferenceTips.resourceManagement: Track stamina, gear, and limited-use combat techniques.
quickReferenceTips.environmental: Use lighting, footing, obstacles, and terrain to your advantage.
quickReferenceTips.teamwork: Coordinate defense, first aid, and focused attacks.
